repairs.quote: Note that the dashes will stay in the Domain Tables Technical Reference, however the FIRM DB template will not have dashes, and neither will DVT accept them/require them.
repairs.reason: The reference prints `0.2-PCT-ANNUAL-CHANCE FLOOD HAZARD` and says the database will not have the dashes. The service agrees: it publishes `0.2 PCT ANNUAL CHANCE FLOOD HAZARD` and never the dashed form. The repair is scoped to the PCT phrases rather than every dash, because the service publishes `AREA WITH UNDETERMINED FLOOD HAZARD DUE TO NON-ACCREDITED LEVEE SYSTEM` with its dash and never without one.
